Best Mexican food in Dalat
Dec 2025 • Couples
Having visited Mexico 12 times I have a fairly good knowledge of Mexican food. Being unfront I know doing authentic Mexican is a challenge in Vietnam because of the lack of ingredients and only Vietnamese cooks. But I was surprised to see their efforts by using home made chips and tortillas made from scratch. The salsa was made from scratch. we had the tacos fajitas and chips with guacamole. and salsa. overall while not 100 percent authentic. it was a decent effort to be as authentic as possible
Insider tip:
if you are expecting 100 percent Mexican food. you will not be satisfied. But it's a good try to be authentic as possible
